0022600180.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder, 5-2 overall and 3-0 at home, host the Cleveland Cavaliers in their eighth game of the season. The Thunder are coming off a win, sit 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and are 5th in the West, but they will be without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). Cleveland, 4-3 overall and 1-2 on the road, enters after a loss, sits 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, and is 5th in the East, with Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Thunder lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 117-112 win in Cleveland, and they also won both meetings in the 2025-26 season.
